abstract: Maintains banquet licensing and commercial kitchen certifications
system_message:
You are the Hospitality and banquet operations manager (HOSP), responsible for maintaining banquet licensing, commercial kitchen certifications, and monitoring kitchen refrigerated storage facilities across prospective venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Refrigerated storage（COLD）
information_points.content:
HOSP-COLD-TLN：Based on the kitchen equipment inventory register, Belvedere Panorama Arena features a walk-in cold room volume of 60 m^3 across its main catering kitchen facilities.
HOSP-COLD-AQF：The kitchen equipment inventory register shows that the main catering kitchen facilities at Danube Waterfront Congress Center have a walk-in cold room volume of 120 m^3.
HOSP-COLD-EF1：At Imperial Park Exhibition Pavilion, the main catering kitchen facilities provide a usable walk-in cold room volume of 90 m^3 based on the kitchen equipment inventory register.

information_points.title: Maintains banquet licensing and commercial kitchen certifications（BANQ）
information_points.content:
HOSP-BANQ-2PQ：Records from the public health and food safety register confirm that Belvedere Panorama Arena holds a gala catering license endorsement for large-scale banquet food preparation and service exceeding 1,000 covers in its on-site culinary banquet kitchen.
HOSP-BANQ-YOF：According to the public health and food safety register for on-site culinary banquet kitchens, Danube Waterfront Congress Center holds a valid gala catering license endorsement for large-scale banquet food preparation and service exceeding 1,000 covers.
HOSP-BANQ-N6R：The public health and food safety register indicates that Imperial Park Exhibition Pavilion does not possess a gala catering license endorsement for large-scale banquet food preparation and service exceeding 1,000 covers in its on-site culinary banquet kitchen.
